title: Pistachio and Cherry Bombe
summary: A dome of vanilla ice cream wrapped in a soft pistachio biscuit, with a ripple of cooked cherries running through the centre.
equipment: a smaller bowl that nests inside

ingredients.note: 570 ml for the lining, 140 ml with the cherries, 140 ml for the top

steps.title: Grind
steps.text: Grind 375 g pistachios with 150 g caster sugar in a food processor to a fine meal.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir in the lemon zest, 1 tbsp honey and 3 egg whites by hand to a sticky dough.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Press the dough onto a paper-lined tray to about 8 mm thick and bake at 180 °C for 25-30 min, until coloured on top but still soft enough that a finger dent stays.

steps.title: Line
steps.text: Line a 2 litre bowl with baking paper and cling film, then press two-thirds of the warm biscuit into the bowl in an even 8 mm layer and leave to cool for 1 h; roll the reserved third between sheets of paper to 8 mm, trim it to the size of the bowl's opening and set aside.

steps.title: Cherries
steps.text: Cook 225 g cherries with 1 tbsp sugar over medium heat for 10 min until soft and juicy, then cool completely.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Soften the ice cream for 10 min and spread 570 ml over the biscuit lining in a 2.5 cm layer, tamping it down with a smaller bowl, then freeze for 2-3 h.

steps.title: Centre
steps.text: Fold the cooled cherries and their juice through 140 ml softened ice cream, leaving ripples of colour, spoon into the centre and freeze for 2-3 h.

steps.title: Cap
steps.text: Spread the final 140 ml ice cream over the top, press on the biscuit lid and freeze for at least 8 h or overnight.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Turn the bombe out, dust with icing sugar, grate a few pistachios over, decorate with fresh cherries and slice at once.

tips: Press the warm biscuit into the bowl while it's still pliable, as it firms up and cracks once cool.
Let each ice cream layer firm up in the freezer before adding the next so the layers stay distinct.
Turn the bombe out just before serving and slice it while still very cold for neat portions.
storage: The assembled bombe keeps well frozen, tightly wrapped, for up to a week before turning out and serving.
